title: BPhO Round 1 is live
body: BPhO Round 1 mock tests are now available under Physics — 10 questions, 60 minutes, calculator allowed, numeric answers with 2% tolerance.

title: LaTeX rendering overhaul
body: Bare LaTeX in solutions (e.g. x^{3/8}) is now auto-wrapped server-side. If you still spot raw math text anywhere, please report it.
